etna_summary_en: After an ash-emission phase at the North-East Crater in late September (plume up to ~5.5 km on 26–27 Sep, aviation code RED on 29 Sep), the latest INGV bulletin reports low-to-medium tremor and decreasing infrasound. No new INGV communiqués found since 30 Sep.
